verdict.rationale: Data region or residency is a fair question for Pipecat, since Pipecat Cloud is a hosted platform, but the pack documents no region selection or data-residency control. Pipecat is pip-installable and self-hostable, and bots are portable to self-hosting, so users could pick their own infrastructure. That is a user-side deployment arrangement, not a documented residency feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
